title: RWB-S7-E6028-APP: no source publishes a sale-selection operation or a sold-population read, placement_type and the sale reference have no column, field ID or list, the entry state PLACEMENT_DECIDED is produced by an unclaimed rule, AC2's R-WO-12 is already built by RWB-S7-E6018-APP, the hand-off to rwb-debtsale has no edge, the debt sale officer holds right R only, and the plan's C row is empty while the step consumes three contracts
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6028-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-028; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.1 to A1.4, A2.16, Requirements served and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12, R-WO-29, R-WO-32 and R-WO-50; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-16 and integration INT-16
description: (1) No source publishes an operation for the sale selection or for the sold population: TSD S7 T-A.1 lists only API-S7-001 POST /write-off-scans and API-S7-002 POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision, and the legacy Endpoints table of RWB-E6-028 repeats those same two rows, so both operations of this step are invented as placeholders and their paths, operation IDs and element names are confirmed by no document. (2) placement_type, the only condition of R-WO-32, has no column in write_off (TSD S7 T3.1 lists DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020), no field ID in the FSD S7 A2.16.3.2 field catalog and no list of values; TSD S7 T3.2 is an empty list-of-values table. (3) The sale reference the selection opens has no column, no field ID, no format and no owner rule. (4) The entry state PLACEMENT_DECIDED is produced by R-WO-29 'Decide the post charge-off treatment under D9.3', a row no story of the S7 split claims: the 16 features FEAT-WOF-01 to -16 carry the scan, the pack, the committee, the posting, the provision feed, the reconciliation, the exception loop, the retention close, the criteria change, the post charge-off payment and the sale, and the placement with an agency is FEAT-PRM-06 in S9, so the state this step starts from has no builder in this service. (5) AC2 of this legacy key is R-WO-12, from PACK_PREPARED to ESCALATED_TO_CREDIT_COMMITTEE, which is the same rule and the same branch that legacy RWB-E6-018 owns as its AC3 and that RWB-S7-E6018-APP already builds, so one rule is delivered twice by two legacy keys and the criterion is owned word for word by both. (6) The connection matrix gives S7 no cell toward S6 (row S7 names Temporal to P7 and P8 and REST and events to P1 only) and gives S6 none toward S7, so the hand-off 'Hand the charged-off population to the debt sale route' has no REST edge, no event name and no queue in any source. (7) FSD S7 A2.16.3.3 gives the step to the debt sale officer and the Head of Asset Liquidity, while TSD S7 T6.1 gives RW-DEBTSALE right R on Write-off and posting and carries no Head of Asset Liquidity row, so no role of the capability area holds a write right for the selection. (8) The legacy screen table for SCR-27 gives the states 'Scan; proposed; in committee; approved' and carries no post-charge-off or sold state, which is the only state this step has. (9) The plan's C row is empty while the step consumes the rwb-case case read, the rwb-case case-move answer and the rwb-decision package read, and DP-04, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-11 are absent from its pattern set although the step evaluates a WO package, touches ACE-sourced facts, owns a topic and replaces a legacy in-process call to the debt sale route. (10) The plan's reqs row is empty while FSD S7 Requirements served gives REQ-S7-006 for post charge-off treatment by rule, and TSD S7 T8 maps all eight REQ-S7 rows to FEAT-WOF-01. (11) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives the error status codes with no message ID per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy set by assumption.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 (two operations only) and T-A.2; FSD S7 A2.16.3.1, A2.16.3.2 and A2.16.3.3; TSD S7 T3.1, T3.2 and T4 (51 rules over 27 states); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12, R-WO-29 and R-WO-32; context pack row S7 of the connection matrix; legacy RWB-E6-028 Endpoints, Data, Screen and states and Permission checks; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-WOF-16; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6028-APP (C row empty, reqs empty)
area: S7 rwb-writeoff, sale selection and post charge-off population
owner_role: Solution architect, business lead and the rwb-writeoff tech lead
proposed: Declare the two operations on /api/recovery/writeoff/v1 with placeholder paths and element names confirmed by the solution architect; read placement_type and the sale reference as request inputs with placeholder value sets and no column; start the step at PLACEMENT_DECIDED and record that R-WO-29 is unclaimed in S7; assert R-WO-12 on the branch RWB-S7-E6018-APP builds instead of building it twice; describe the hand-off as the case move plus the published population read and declare no event; declare the selection at right C with the role conflict recorded; state the post-charge-off and sold states as edge placeholders; build against the three consumed rows as class C dependencies; trace to REQ-S7-006 from the FSD row.

title: RWB-S7-E6028-CON: the two operations, their paths, operation IDs and element names, the placement_type and sale-reference placeholders, the consumed operation names, the decision code set, the role right of the sale and the paging of the population read have no published baseline, and the error set carries no message ID per condition
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6028-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-028; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.16.2, A2.16.3.1, A2.16.3.2, A2.16.3.3, A2.16.4.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.3, T6.1, T8, T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12 and R-WO-32
description: (1) No source publishes the sale-selection operation or the sold-population read, so the baseline declares two operations whose paths, operation IDs, element names, required flags and types are invented placeholders; TSD S7 T-A.1 publishes API-S7-001 and API-S7-002 only. (2) TSD S7 T-A.2 publishes element names for those two operations only and no property, required flag, type or message ID per condition for any other operation, so every property of the three new elements is fixed by this baseline. (3) placement_type and the sale reference have no value set, no length, no format and no field ID in any source, and TSD S7 T3.2 publishes no list of values at all, so both carry a placeholder and no enumeration. (4) The decision code the record carries has no value set: the legacy Data table names decision_code as a ledger field and the rules name the event SALE_SELECTED, but no source publishes the code the selection writes. (5) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, so the case move is declared as the child workflow's stage outcome and the REST row carries a placeholder. (6) The paging convention of the population read, its filter parameter and the right of a service identity to read it are not published; the platform paging convention is reused as an assumption. (7) The role and right of the sale selection conflict: the FSD gives the step to the debt sale officer and the Head of Asset Liquidity, TSD S7 T6.1 gives RW-DEBTSALE right R and has no Head of Asset Liquidity row, and the legacy permission table carries only the committee right A and the scan right C. (8) TSD S7 T8 maps every REQ-S7 row to FEAT-WOF-01 while the FSD Requirements served table gives REQ-S7-006 for post charge-off treatment by rule, so the contract's requirement trace rests on the FSD row. (9) The connection matrix gives no S7 to S6 edge, so the population read that rwb-debtsale consumes is declared provided here without a matching consumed row in any S6 document, and no event is declared for the hand-off.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 and T-A.2; TSD S7 T3.1 and T3.2; TSD S7 T6.1 and T8; FSD S7 A2.16.2, A2.16.3.1, A2.16.3.2, A2.16.3.3 and A2.16.4.4; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-12 and R-WO-32; legacy RWB-E6-028 Endpoints, Permission checks and Screen and states; context pack row S7 of the connection matrix; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6028-CON
area: S7 rwb-writeoff, contract baseline of the sale selection
owner_role: Solution architect, business lead, rwb-writeoff tech lead and the rwb-debtsale owner
proposed: Publish one OpenAPI 3.1 document with the two operations, their placeholders and the error envelope of one message ID per condition; declare the three elements over DF-FIN-010 to DF-FIN-020 with the placement_type and sale-reference placeholders; declare the three consumed rows with placeholders for their operation names; declare the rights C and R and the role conflict as a carried assumption; declare the decision-record element with the chain to the approval record; publish five fakes and the drift, vocabulary and absence tests; declare no event and no Schedule; trace to REQ-S7-006 from the FSD row.
